presentation.fr: Essai de <ph id='marcuse'>Marcuse</ph> sur la société industrielle avancée, qui neutralise toute opposition en satisfaisant les besoins qu'elle crée. Il devint l'un des livres de chevet de la contestation de 1968.
presentation.en: An essay by <ph id='marcuse'>Marcuse</ph> on advanced industrial society, which neutralizes all opposition by satisfying the needs it creates. It became one of the touchstone books of the 1968 protest movements.
